# THE OTHER POST-CANCEL RETURN — a NEW enquiry, not the cancelled visit.
#
# Same release, opposite half of the rule: the client cancelled the Олимпико
# visit and comes back with new criteria («3 спални до 200 евра»). The chat
# re-opens FRESH — the intake lane answers it. Resuming the visit lane here
# would ask «Кој термин би Ви одговарал за посета?» and the owner would be
# asked about EB 62, a property this message never mentions.
!state visit_scheduling
